parts.text: From Source 1, identify the trend in worldwide internet use.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: From Source 2, identify two benefits of digital technology.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Which benefit of digital technology do you think is the most significant? Explain why.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Explain how the use of digital technology has important personal consequences.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
‘Data from digital technologies improves our lives.’
What are the strengths and weaknesses of the argument supporting this claim?

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘Digital communication strengthens our relationships.’
How could you test this claim?
You should consider the types of information, sources of evidence and methods you might
use.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Identify one fact from Kari’s statement. Explain why it is a fact.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why Lars’ statement might be biased.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Which argument is more convincing, Kari’s or Lars’?
Your answer should consider both arguments and you should support your point of view with
their words.
You should also consider:
• the strength of their reasoning and evidence
• their use of language
• the different kinds of information used.

text: ‘Personal data from digital technology should remain private and never be used by other people
Do you agree with this statement?
• give reasons and evidence to support your opinion
• use the material in the sources and/or any of your own ideas
